cards.title: Ringg Raises $10M Series A Extension
cards.body: India's voice AI startup Ringg secured $10 million in Series A extension funding from Peak XV Partners. The company is expanding voice AI capabilities beyond traditional phone calls.

cards.title: Generalist Reaches $3B Valuation
cards.body: Physical AI robotics startup Generalist hit a $3 billion valuation after raising $200 million. The milestone comes months after the company reached its previous $2 billion valuation.

cards.title: OpenAI Infrastructure Executive Departs
cards.body: OpenAI's top data center executive is leaving amid ongoing high-profile departures. The company recently reorganized its infrastructure organization to support scaling operations.

cards.title: Stability AI Raises $76M Funding
cards.body: Stability AI, creator of Stable Diffusion, secured $76 million in fresh funding. The company's total fundraising now reaches $232 million.

cards.title: Claude Gains Shared Memory Feature
cards.body: Anthropic launched shared memory across Claude chat and Cowork applications. Users no longer need to repeatedly brief the AI on projects and preferences.

cards.title: Gamma Acquires Design Startup Lica
cards.body: Gamma acquired Accel-backed design startup Lica. The Lica co-founders will join Gamma's new research team.

cards.title: OpenAI's Jalapeño Chip Benchmarks
cards.body: OpenAI's Jalapeño chip outperforms current state-of-the-art on inference benchmarks. The custom chip demonstrates superior tokens per user and throughput per kilowatt efficiency.

cards.title: Keenable Exits Stealth With $26M
cards.body: Accel-backed Keenable launched from stealth with $26 million seed funding. The startup is building a web search index specifically designed for AI agents.

cards.title: OpenAI Head of Product Interview
cards.body: TechCrunch interviewed OpenAI's head of product Thibault Sottiaux on AI agents and UX. Sottiaux discussed the company's product strategy under executive Greg Brockman.

cards.title: Situational Awareness Hedge Fund Probed
cards.body: AI hedge fund Situational Awareness is under SEC investigation. The firm rapidly shifted from Wall Street prominence to facing federal subpoenas.

cards.title: Trump Invests in SpaceX Post-IPO
cards.body: President Trump purchased SpaceX shares two weeks after the blockbuster IPO. He bought shares at $150 range while stock finished trading at $135 IPO price.

cards.title: Replit CEO Joins TechCrunch Disrupt
cards.body: Replit CEO and co-founder Amjad Masad will speak at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026. He will share perspectives on the future of programming.

cards.title: Instinct AI Assistant Raises Concerns
cards.body: AI assistant Instinct generates enthusiasm among early testers but raises privacy concerns. The tool's broad access and ability to act on users' behalf create security trade-offs.

cards.title: General Intuition Reaches $6B Valuation
cards.body: General Intuition raised funding at $6 billion pre-money valuation from Valor Ventures and Point72. The startup is developing foundation models for AI agents in robotics.

cards.title: OpenAI Pushes AI Agents Mainstream
cards.body: OpenAI is developing AI agents for diverse applications beyond software engineering. The frontier lab is expanding agent technology to reach general users.

cards.title: Hugging Face In $13B Acquisition Talks
cards.body: Hugging Face is reportedly fielding acquisition offers around $13 billion valuation. Founders' commitment to community platforms may complicate a potential sale.

cards.title: Mysterious Ox Alpha Model Emerges
cards.body: A stealth AI model called Ox Alpha has sparked internet speculation about its creators. The mysterious model has driven discussion in certain AI communities.

cards.title: Linkdaze Smart Calendar Launches
cards.body: Linkdaze introduced a smart digital calendar with free AI features including meal planning. The calendar focuses on household management beyond basic scheduling.

cards.title: Flock Safety Faces Surveillance Backlash
cards.body: Flock Safety's surveillance technology is drawing growing public criticism. CEO calls for 'compromise' amid concerns about potential misuse of the platform.

cards.title: Copyright Training of AI Models Disputed
cards.body: Authors' copyrighted books have been used to train AI models without consent. The legal status of this practice remains complicated and contested.

cards.title: India's Ringg Raises $10M for Voice AI Beyond Calls
cards.body: Ringg secured Series A extension funding from Peak XV to expand voice AI capabilities beyond traditional phone interactions. The startup is pushing the boundaries of conversational AI applications.

cards.title: Generalist Robotics Startup Hits $3B Valuation
cards.body: The physical AI startup reached $3 billion valuation with a $200 million funding extension. Generalist is advancing AI-powered robotic systems and autonomous capabilities.

cards.title: OpenAI Loses Top Data Center Executive
cards.body: OpenAI's infrastructure head departed amid ongoing high-profile departures from the company. OpenAI recently reorganized its infrastructure organization to support scaling operations.

cards.title: Stability AI Raises $76M for Stable Diffusion
cards.body: Stability AI secured $76 million in fresh funding, bringing total fundraising to $232 million. The company continues developing its generative image AI model.

cards.title: Claude Now Remembers Chat History Across Sessions
cards.body: Anthropic integrated shared memory into Claude, allowing the AI to retain context across conversations. Users no longer need to repeatedly brief the AI on projects and preferences.

cards.title: Gamma Acquires Design Startup Lica
cards.body: Gamma acquired Accel-backed design startup Lica to strengthen its AI capabilities. Lica's co-founders will join Gamma's new research team.

cards.title: OpenAI's Jalapeño Chip Optimized for AI Inference
cards.body: OpenAI's custom Jalapeño chip outperforms state-of-the-art solutions in token throughput and efficiency benchmarks. The chip is designed for fast inference at scale.

cards.title: Keenable Launches Web Index for AI Agents
cards.body: Keenable exited stealth with $26 million seed funding to build a specialized search index for AI agents. The startup is indexing the web to support autonomous AI systems.

cards.title: OpenAI's Head of Product Discusses AI Agents
cards.body: Thibault Sottiaux, OpenAI's head of product, discussed the company's strategy on AI agents and UX design. OpenAI is preparing to scale agent capabilities to broader audiences.

cards.title: AI Hedge Fund Situational Awareness Probed by SEC
cards.body: The high-profile AI hedge fund faces federal investigation after rapid decline from Wall Street prominence. The company faced subpoenas as its investment strategy came under scrutiny.

cards.title: Instinct AI Assistant Raises Privacy Concerns
cards.body: Instinct's powerful AI assistant draws praise but sparks security concerns over broad system access. Users worry about the sweeping permissions granted to autonomous AI agents.

cards.title: General Intuition Raises $6B for Robotics AI
cards.body: General Intuition secured funding at $6 billion valuation from Valor Ventures and Point72. The startup is developing foundation models for generalized AI agents in robotics.

cards.title: OpenAI Pushes AI Agents to Mass Market
cards.body: OpenAI is expanding autonomous AI agents beyond software engineers to general users. The frontier lab is making AI agents more accessible and practical for everyday tasks.

cards.title: Hugging Face in $13B Acquisition Talks
cards.body: Hugging Face is reportedly fielding acquisition offers valued around $13 billion. Founders' community commitment raises questions about whether the deal will close.

cards.title: Mystery AI Model Ox Alpha Sparks Speculation
cards.body: A mysterious new AI model called Ox Alpha has generated significant internet intrigue and speculation. Details about the model's creators and capabilities remain unknown.

cards.title: Copyright Law Complexities in AI Model Training
cards.body: Authors' works have been used to train AI models without consent or knowledge, raising legal questions. Copyright implications of large-scale AI training remain legally ambiguous.

cards.title: MIT Study: AI Chatbots Distort News Perception
cards.body: MIT Media Lab research shows AI-based news assistants reduced critical headline evaluation by 21%. The study raises concerns about AI's role in information consumption.

cards.title: Apple Designs Macs Specifically for Local AI
cards.body: Apple's new desktop computers are optimized for running AI models locally without cloud dependency. The machines target developers building on-device AI applications.

cards.title: AI Won't Replace Radiologists, Just Change Jobs
cards.body: AI tools are transforming radiology roles rather than eliminating them entirely. Radiologists will focus on complex cases while AI handles routine image analysis.

cards.title: Stanford Study: AI Hits Entry-Level Jobs Hardest
cards.body: New research finds AI adoption disproportionately affects entry-level job positions. The technology is automating tasks traditionally performed by junior-level workers.

cards.title: Nvidia Manager Tied to AI Smuggling Scheme
cards.body: A senior Nvidia manager is connected to an AI equipment smuggling operation. The incident involves former Supermicro staff coordinating unauthorized exports.
